title: effected config
description:
The effected build config, effected.toml. A root file at the workspace root and a package file in each package are discovered and merged, the package's over the root's, and the merged file is decoded strictly: an unknown key fails the build.
https://github.com/spencerbeggs/effected/tree/main/packages/bundler

format.description: Output module formats. ESM-only by default; add "cjs" for a dual-format build.

items.title: Module format
items.description: A module format the build emits: esm or cjs.

bundle.description: Packages force-bundled into the JS output, even ones package.json declares. Declarations are not inlined; use bundledPackages for that.

bundledPackages.description: External packages whose declarations are inlined into the bundled .d.ts. A workspace sibling inlines from its built declarations, so build it first.

dtsExternals.description: Packages externalized in the declaration pass only. Declare them as dependencies so consumers can resolve the emitted imports.

bundleNodeModules.description: Bundles node_modules and workspace dependencies that are not external into the JS output and the declarations alike.

minify.description: Minifies the output. Off by default: minified Node libraries trip security scanners.

emitDts.description: Runs the declaration pass and, with it, the meta pass. false is for JS-only artifacts; meta = false disables only the API model.

define.description: Compile-time replacements forwarded to the build's define. Values are inserted verbatim, so a string literal carries its own quotes.

plugins.description: Package-relative modules whose default export is a rolldown plugin or a factory of one.

overrides.description: Format and bundling settings pinned to some export paths, layered onto the base build.

entries.description: Export paths pinned to this partition, or "." for the root.

format.description: Output module formats for this partition.

items.title: Module format
items.description: A module format the build emits: esm or cjs.

bundle.description: Packages force-bundled into this partition's JS output.

externals.description: Packages kept external in this partition.

bundleNodeModules.description: Whether this partition bundles its node_modules dependencies.

bundledPackages.description: Packages whose declarations are inlined into this partition's .d.ts. A workspace sibling must be built first.

dtsExternals.description: Packages externalized in this partition's declaration pass only.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The platform the JS pass targets.

enumValues: No platform: neither Node nor browser built-ins.

css.description: CSS handling forwarded to tsdown's css option on the JS pass. tsdown owns the shape.

outSubdir.description: Builds this partition as an isolated sub-package in pkg/<outSubdir>/, so the export's built path becomes ./<outSubdir>/index.js. Pin exactly one export path.

items.title: Entry override
items.description: Format and bundling settings pinned to some export paths, layered onto the base build. Every setting but entries is absent unless written, and absent means the base build's value.

source.description: The source module bundled into the file.

format.title: Module format
format.description: A module format the build emits: esm or cjs.

anyOf.title: Loose file
anyOf.description: One standalone output file's source and format. The format is inferred from an .mjs or .cjs key and required only for a .js key.

additionalProperties.description: A source path, or a table naming the source and its format.

looseFiles.description: Standalone files at literal output paths, outside the exports, declaration and meta graph. Each key is an output filename.

copy.description: Non-module assets copied into each group's pkg/ directory. A directory keeps its basename. public/ is copied with no config.

from.description: Source paths or globs, relative to the package. A directory keeps its own basename under to, so from = "../../schemas" with to = "schemas" emits pkg/schemas/schemas/.

to.description: The destination directory, relative to the group's pkg/ root, which is the default. It may not leave pkg/.

flatten.description: Whether to drop each source's directory structure. tsdown defaults this to true.

anyOf.title: Copy entry
anyOf.description: A non-module asset copied into each group's pkg/ directory, in the shape of tsdown's copy option.

items.description: A path or glob copied into the pkg/ root, or a table with a destination.

enumValues: Auto-imports the JSX factories from importSource.

importSource.description: The JSX import source for the automatic runtime.

jsx.title: JSX
jsx.description: JSX transform settings. Inferred from the package's tsconfig when absent.

drop.description: Top-level keys dropped from the emitted package.json, beyond the ones always stripped.

set.description: Top-level string keys written over the emitted package.json, after drop. name renames the package everywhere the build names it. Keys the build or the release owns, such as version, exports and the dependency maps, fail validation.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: What the build changes in the emitted package.json.

localPaths.description: Directories, relative to the package, that the canonical group's API model is copied into, for a docs site that reads the model from its own tree.

optimistic.description: Forward-looks the meta bundle's versions to their next release versions from pending changesets. "auto" is false under CI and true locally.

suppressWarnings.description: API Extractor messages to suppress. Defaults to the _base forgotten-export every Schema.Class synthesizes. A list replaces the default, so an empty list suppresses nothing.

messageId.description: The exact API Extractor message id.

pattern.description: A regex or substring matched against the message text.

items.title: Warning suppression
items.description: An API Extractor message-suppression rule. A rule with both messageId and pattern needs both to match; a rule with neither matches nothing.

tagName.description: The tag's name, with its leading @.

enumValues: A block tag, which owns the text after it.
An inline tag, written inside braces.
A modifier tag, which carries no content.

allowMultiple.description: Whether a declaration may carry the tag more than once.

items.title: TSDoc tag
items.description: A custom TSDoc tag definition, as API Extractor's TSDoc config takes it.

tsdoc.title: TSDoc
tsdoc.description: TSDoc and documentation-warning settings for the API model.

anyOf.title: API model
anyOf.description: API model generation settings, the [package.build.meta] table.

meta.description: The API model's settings, or false to opt out and still run the declaration pass. Generated with defaults when absent.

fileName.description: The output binary's basename, with no extension or suffix.

nodeVersion.description: The Node runtime version to embed.

disableExperimentalSEAWarning.description: Whether to silence Node's experimental SEA warning.

useCodeCache.description: Whether to embed V8's code cache.

useSnapshot.description: Whether to embed a V8 startup snapshot.

seaConfig.title: SEA config
seaConfig.description: Single-executable seaConfig overrides, merged over the defaults.

targets.description: Explicit targets. Inferred from the package's os and cpu fields when absent.

platform.description: The platform, using tsdown's win token rather than win32.

items.title: Executable target
items.description: A single-executable target platform and architecture.

fileName.description: The output binary's basename, with no extension or suffix.

nodeVersion.description: The Node runtime version to embed.

disableExperimentalSEAWarning.description: Whether to silence Node's experimental SEA warning.

useCodeCache.description: Whether to embed V8's code cache.

useSnapshot.description: Whether to embed a V8 startup snapshot.

seaConfig.title: SEA config
seaConfig.description: Single-executable seaConfig overrides, merged over the defaults.

targets.description: Explicit targets. Inferred from the package's os and cpu fields when absent.

platform.description: The platform, using tsdown's win token rather than win32.

items.title: Executable target
items.description: A single-executable target platform and architecture.

exe.description: Single-executable binaries to compile: one table, or a list of them.

PackageBuildConfig.title: Package build
PackageBuildConfig.description: The build settings of one package, the [package.build] table. Every key has a default or is absent, so an empty table is a complete config.

path.description: A bundle-relative asset path. Mutually exclusive with url.

url.description: An absolute external URL, used verbatim. Mutually exclusive with path.

type.description: The MIME type. Inferred from the extension when absent.

alt.description: The alt text. Inferred when absent.

BundleOpenGraphImage.title: Open Graph image
BundleOpenGraphImage.description: One Open Graph image the API docs declare. Exactly one of path and url must be present.

images.description: Static images, by path or url. Listed after a generated image.

themeColor.description: The embed accent color, a CSS color string.

generate.description: Renders an image at build time, listed first.

enumValues: Renders the card with satori, the only renderer.

cacheSalt.description: The generated image cache's salt: change it when the renderer's output changes. false always regenerates; absent uses the renderer's own salt.

BundleOpenGraphConfig.title: Open Graph
BundleOpenGraphConfig.description: The Open Graph settings of the package's API docs.

type.description: The protocol family. Unknown values are accepted.

url.description: The package's URL on that registry instance.

BundleRegistryRef.title: Registry
BundleRegistryRef.description: One registry the documented package is published to.

registries.description: The registries the package is published to. false disables the default derived from targets.json.

BundleConfig.title: Bundle
BundleConfig.description: The config tier of the emitted bundle.json, the [package.bundle] table.

PackageConfig.title: Package
PackageConfig.description: The [package] table: the package's build settings and its bundle.json config tier.

pre.description: The source of the entry that runs before main. Absent, a conventional src/pre.ts builds when it exists.

post.description: The source of the entry that runs after main, for cleanup. Absent, a conventional src/post.ts builds when it exists.

source.description: The worker's source, relative to the package.

importCheck.description: Whether this worker's bundle is imported after the build to prove it loads. [action.build] importCheck = false turns the check off for every bundle, this one included.

anyOf.title: Action worker
anyOf.description: A worker written as a table, for a worker that needs more than its source. A plain string is the source with every setting at its default.

additionalProperties.description: The worker's source, or a table of its settings.

workers.description: Extra bundles outside the lifecycle, each emitted as dist/<name>.js: a name to its source, or to a table of its own.

ActionEntries.title: Action entries
ActionEntries.description: The bundles the action ships, the [action.entries] table. main, pre and post are the lifecycle entries action.yml runs; a worker is a bundle the action loads itself.

externals.description: Packages left out of the bundles and imported at runtime, beside node: builtins.

ignore.description: Packages left out of the bundles and replaced with a stub that throws if loaded, for an optional dependency the action never exercises.

importCheck.description: Whether to import each bundle in a fresh Node after building it, proving it loads. Turn it off for an action with no GITHUB_ACTIONS guard, because the import runs it for real.

ActionBuildOptions.title: Action build
ActionBuildOptions.description: How the action's bundles are built, the [action.build] table.

requireActionYml.description: Whether action.yml must exist and be valid.

maxBundleSize.description: The size past which a bundle is reported.

strict.description: Whether a warning is an error. Absent, it is under CI and is not locally.

ActionValidationOptions.title: Action validation
ActionValidationOptions.description: What an action build checks before it builds, the [action.validation] table.

enabled.description: Whether to copy the build output locally.

path.description: The local action directory, relative to the package.

actTemplate.description: Whether to generate the act boilerplate, .actrc and act-test.yml, when those files do not exist.

ActionPersistLocalOptions.title: Local action copy
ActionPersistLocalOptions.description: The local copy of the action's build for testing with nektos/act, the [action.persistLocal] table.

ActionConfig.title: Action
ActionConfig.description: A GitHub Action's build settings, the [action] table. Every key has a default, so an empty table is a complete config; a file with no [action] table is a library.
